plan: tasks/todo.md, P5 'The run that moves nobody'

funnel.what: runs and pairs of the analysis set per match, both halves, from count_tracking (counts; the calibration pairs are cross-checked against the pairs the estimator formed)

cadence.what: second differences of position of a player detected at k-1, k, k+1 (metres, 10 Hz): the fraction that are null (exactly, and below half the coordinate grid), and the autocorrelation of |acceleration| by lag, pooled over players with each player's mean removed; a tracking that changes slope every c frames shows null second differences between knots and its first local maximum at lag c (cadence_lag_frames), and a window shorter than c frames cannot see a residual

windows.rule: the protocol lets task 49 shorten W or V once, to the minimum the cadence admits; both already exceed it, so neither changes

run_length.what: metres between the runner's tracked positions at frame_start and frame_end, against the protocol's minimum run length

placebo_design.what: three properties of the placebo each pair of the analysis set got, before any null: the gap |t' - t_c| in seconds; whether the runner holds a player_possession covering t' (an off-ball placebo with the runner on the ball, from the offset rule); and the instants shared by several pairs (same runner, same t': the placebo quantity is the same in each), with the possessions shared by several pairs alongside

units.unit: the connected component, inside the match, of the pairs that share associated_player_possession_event_id or a placebo instant (same runner, same t'); the null flips the sign of every pair of a unit together, and never across matches (possession ids and frames repeat from match to match)

standardisation.what: sd of the placebo leg's values pooled over the calibration half, the unit of every standardised effect from here on, fixed and never recomputed; the sd of the pair values (run minus placebo) alongside, the noise the power simulates

marker.what: the quantity whose direction is forced: the marker's residual displacement along the run, run minus placebo, every run together (no subtype), per match and pooled, in metres and in placebo sd, against the bar

line_against_provider.what: the protocol's line height at t_c (mean x_att of the two deepest outfield opponents) against the provider's last_defensive_line_x_start read as given, an x in the attack frame of the running team; the provider's own identity x_start + height_start = pitch_length / 2 is checked per match (the largest |residual| over the runs, against the match's half length and against a fixed 52.5), so the height needs the match's pitch length to be turned into an x; a contrast of the instrument, never an outcome

null.what: the bar applied to null data sets built from placebo quantities alone (review of task 49): the value of a pair is placebo 1 minus placebo 2 of the marker displacement, centred per subtype over the half (centring_mean_m, so a common mean cannot make the blocks share a sign); each data set is a sign flip of every block inside its match, shared by the subtypes, and on each the whole bar as the real test applies it: the sign count over the matches and a permutation p from inner flips of the units; fires_pct is how often it passes per subtype, at_least_one_pct over the ten; unflipped is the bar on the raw placebo 1 minus placebo 2 of the subtype, a placebo-against-placebo contrast (uncentred: on the centred values the pooled statistic is zero by construction)
null.quantity: marker displacement along the run, placebo 1 minus placebo 2
null.second_placebo: the candidate choose_placebo would pick next: admissible under the same rule, supported by the tracking and with a readable leg, nearest to t_c (ties to the earlier), other than the first and with a window disjoint from the first's (another period, or more than 2.5 s away); a pair without one leaves the null set
null.units: the connected component of the null pairs that share a possession or a placebo instant, (runner, t'1) or (runner, t'2), inside the match: the inner test flips them, as the real test flips its units
null.blocks: the connected component of the null pairs that share a possession, a placebo instant or (runner, period of the run), inside the match: the outer flips, coarser than the units and nesting them, so a dependence the units do not see makes the inner test fire above its nominal rate

hardening.rule: if at_least_one_pct exceeds 5.0 the bar hardens once, in task 49, with the figure written in the protocol's history; it never loosens

power.what: MDE80 per subtype and half: the smallest effect of the grid, in placebo sd, that passes the bar in at least 80 % of simulated data sets; each pair carries the effect plus noise with the pooled sd of the pair values and the measured within-unit correlation, on the unit sizes of the half's matches (the closed half contributes counts and nothing else); the bar as it is applied to real pairs: the sign count over the matches, and the permutation count drawn as Binomial(n_permutations, two-sided normal tail of the data set's z), passing when (1 + count) / (1 + n_permutations) is at most p_at_most

probable.rule: MDE80 at most 0.3 placebo sd in both halves; M1 counts the marker quantity, the forced-direction instrument; the line and the intersection are listed alongside

M1.rule: fewer than 2 probable subtypes -> P5 dies

M2.rule: the instrument does not pass the bar in calibration -> P5 dies
